=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:line 98 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `claimed` success telemetry log fires unconditionally after the claim POST block, including when the `ai:claude` label POST fails and `CLAIM_OK` is false.
  WHY: Operators and log scrapers observe a claimed signal for an issue whose claim failed, dispatch was skipped, and failure path ran.
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:lines 86-97 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The stale-label cleanup loop runs unconditionally even when `CLAIM_OK` is false.
  WHY: On `/reclarify`, the loop can irreversibly delete phase labels from an issue the handoff could not claim and will not dispatch, without restoring those labels.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR's own checklist states "Handoff never dispatches without the claim" (status: complete; covered by `test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim`). The PR description's broader contract — "The handoff claim is mandatory ... If the `ai:claude` POST fails, no dispatch is sent and the existing `ai:claude-handoff-failed` path runs, with wording that names the cause" — implies the failure path should produce no success-shaped telemetry and should leave the issue's state unchanged.
  Expected change site: scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh line 98 — gate the `claimed` log on `CLAIM_OK="true"`; lines 88-97 — gate the stale-label cleanup on `CLAIM_OK="true"`. Also tests/test_claude_issue_route.py function `test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim` — add assertions that `CLAUDE_ISSUE_HANDOFF claimed` does not appear in stdout and that no stale-label DELETE calls were issued.
  Evidence of absence: Line 98 has no `if [ "${CLAIM_OK}" = "true" ]` guard around the `claimed` log; the log fires unconditionally. The stale-label cleanup at lines 88-97 has no `CLAIM_OK` guard either. The contract test asserts `error claim_label_failed`, `error dispatch_failed`, absence of `dispatches` and `ai:claude-issue-routed:v1`, but never asserts `CLAUDE_ISSUE_HANDOFF claimed` is absent from stdout or that stale-label DELETE calls were absent.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The progress log at docs/implement-plan/issue-6057-recheck-claude-label-at-dispatch.md should reflect the current PR state. The `[claude-twin-sync]` commit (9d6cbf94) is on the current head, meaning `.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md` is already in the branch.
  Expected change site: docs/implement-plan/issue-6057-recheck-claude-label-at-dispatch.md lines 7, 10, 12, 14, 17
  Evidence of absence: Line 7 still says `Status: BLOCKED`, line 10 `Waiting on: phase 1 PR: twin sync`, line 12 `Check-in: none (held for the twin sync; the stage /reclarify resumes arms the wait)`, line 14 `waits for the twin-sync copy`, line 17 `PR open, held for twin sync`. The `last_commit_stat.txt` shows commit 9d6cbf9467f8adab6c96fd23e0b645f7aec8147e is `[claude-twin-sync] claude-issue-pickup: handle refused queue items (#6057)` which copies the pickup file. The twin sync is complete; the log's recorded wait condition is resolved.
  severity=NIT | confidence=5
